messages:
Harper: Quick thread  orbit QBR for Northbridge next Wed. Need final owners, a one-paragraph renewal snapshot, and two explicit exec asks (quota + SSO). Can we split?

Noel: Ill own the rollout metrics + customer adoption chart. Will flag the 2 pilot accounts blocked by capacity.

Isha: Ill write the renewal snapshot + suggested mitigation table. Plan to emphasize the compliance concern on retention.

Marco: Ill take action tracker + enablement gaps. Prefer to keep a 3-line summary in the deck and full timeline in runbook.

Ruth: Ill add the customer quote and usage sparkline to the opening slide. Dropping link to asset in the shared deck now.

Harper: Runbook: https://redwood.app/s/nb-qbr-orbit-runbook-v1 (appendix slide #12). Dry run Tue 4pm PT. Final deck due Tue 11am PT.

bot-deck: QBR template v2 synced at 1767777880 -> /decks/templates/qbr-2025-v2.

Noel: Note on onboarding: 4 pilots total, 2 paused due to region quota errors. Proposed exec ask: "Approve emergency region quota to unblock Northbridge pilots (48h)." Adding to onboarding slide.

Isha: Draft renewal snapshot:
"Northbridge health: 70/100. Main risks: SSO delays preventing seamless access, unclear retention SLAs creating compliance friction, and capacity quotas limiting pilot expansion. With focused exec support on quota approvals and a short burst of engineering for SSO remediation, renewal probability increases significantly."

Marco: Action items (short):
- Isha: post final mitigation table with owners (Mon EOD)
- Noel: onboarding slide + error log (Tue 10am)
- Marco: action tracker + appendix link (Tue 10:45am)
- Ruth: customer quote + visual (pushed)
- Harper: update CRM stage & coordinate dry run (Tue)

Ruth: Added quote: "Integrations moved fast but were paused on region enablement"  shortened for deck. Full quote in appendix.

Noel: Ill paste the infra error here once infra confirms exact text.

Isha: Mitigation ask for exec slide (single line): "Approve region quota + 3 weeks dedicated eng for SSO remediation."

Harper: CRM note: Ill flip SFDC to "At Risk - Exec Assist" after Isha posts final copy. Also will ping Sales Ops to draft quota request.

Noel: small ask for Sales: can someone prepare a short justification (customer impact + ARR at risk) to attach to the quota request?

Marco: will include impact bullets in the action tracker.

Isha: Posting the mitigation copy for quick review: "Mitigations: 1) Prioritize SSO engineering (owner: Product Eng)  ask: ~3 weeks of dedicated bandwidth; 2) Publish retention SLA and confirm with legal (owner: CS/Product); 3) Expedite region quota approvals with Sales Ops/Infra (owner: Infra). Exec ask: approval to allocate quota and short-term eng resources to close SSO."

Noel: wording looks good  small tweak: change "~3 weeks" -> "~2-3 weeks" for flexibility.

Isha: updated.

Harper: Timeline reminder: Tue 11am final deck -> Tue 4pm dry run -> Wed 11am exec. If slides miss the deadline I will reassign.

Ruth: visuals pushed. Please sanity-check colors on slide 1.

Noel: will drop the infra error log by EOD.

Marco: action tracker uploaded and linked to appendix slide. Added owners & due dates.

Harper: thanks all  will update SFDC and send dry run invite once the deck is final. Tagging: @Noel @Isha @Marco @Ruth. :raised_hands:

(4 reactions: :thumbsup: :white_check_mark: :eyes: :rocket:)
